name: Shubham Polyspin Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Shubham Polyspin Ltd in the business of manufacturing polypropylene yarns and sale of services[1] [2]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company manufactures PP Multifilament Yarn/ Fabrics. It also manufactures on JobWork basis and get its products manufactured on Job Work 
basis

pros: Debtor days have improved from 44.4 to 31.6 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 4.68 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.65%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.56% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.31% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.05 Cr.
